# stackit_identity_users (Data Source)

Lists STACKIT Identity users in an organization, optionally filtered by email.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stackit_identity_users" "users" {
  organization_id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
  email_regex     = ".*@stackit\\.cloud"
  sort_ascending  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) STACKIT Organization ID.

### Optional

- `email_regex` (String) Optional regular expression to filter users by email.
- `sort_ascending` (Boolean) If set to `true`, users are sorted in ascending lexicographical order by email. Defaults to `false` (descending).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform's internal resource ID, structured as "`organization_id`".
- `items` (Attributes List) The list of identity users matching the provided filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Display name of the user.
- `email` (String) Email of the user.
- `user_id` (String) The internal UUID of the user.
